market_story: Zero-forcing twin isolates what the merchant floors buy: floors-off simple-mean prices sit HIGHER (twin 32.29/35.10/60.09 vs keeper 29.14/32.00/54.08 for 2023/24/25) because the NYISO reliability/reserve floors force cheap in-city steam-base and CT energy into merit order that the pure-economic LP would leave idle - real NYC/LI locational-reliability commitment (LMIC, D-2 attribution), not residual-buying. The >$300 tail is present in both arms: the floors do not manufacture the level or the scarcity - the tail is the measured hourly reserve-requirement duals plus the measured daily delivered gas. The new NYC 2,875 MW AC-import cap leaves the annual level essentially unchanged vs nyiso-60 (identical twin deltas), confirming NYC AC-import capability is not the binding scarcity lever.
